steps.do: Check from the records: at least one active checking account; the oldest active checking account's date_opened is at least 14 days before the current time (the 14-day tenure runs from that date_opened to date_opened + 14 days); fewer than 5 personal savings accounts; no account in collections or with a negative balance. If tenure is short, tell the customer the date they become eligible (that date_opened + 14 days) and do not open - including when the customer claims the time has passed but get_time_savings shows it has not. If 5 savings exist, say they reached the maximum. If collections/negative balance, say it must be resolved first. If no active checking, say one is required. Stop on any failure.
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

basis.quote: Customer has at least one active Rho-Bank checking account.
The customer’s checking account tenure is at least 14 days.
Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.
Exceeds savings account limit: If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, do not open a new one. Inform the customer they have reached the maximum.
Collections or negative balances: Resolve these issues first; do not proceed until all accounts are in good standing.
